title_en: Why Did You Bear Me, Mother
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear: no author I can name. The second stanza is hard to follow; 'Херој биди мила мајко ти' is my reading ('be a hero, dear mother'), possibly meaning 'be proud'.

audio.who: Гарабет Тавитјан, Гарабет Тавитјан Јр., Диран Тавитјан, Есма Реџепова
